field.label: Sequence
field.help: Views are evaluated from the lowest sequence to the highest. A catch-all view must be last.

field.label: Match any client
field.help: Match every client. Use this only for the final catch-all view.

field.label: Match client ACLs
field.help: Clients matching one of these ACLs are handled by this view. Ignored when Match any client is enabled.

field.label: Match destination ACLs
field.help: Only DNS requests sent to an address in these ACLs are handled by this view. Use separate LAN and WAN destination ACLs for split DNS.

field.label: Recursion
field.help: Permit recursive resolution in this view. Do not enable it in a public authoritative view.

field.label: Allow recursion ACLs
field.help: ACLs allowed to use recursion. If empty, the Match client ACLs are used.

field.label: Allow queries from any client
field.help: Allow all clients to query zones in this view. Normally enabled only for the public authoritative view.

field.label: Allow query ACLs
field.help: ACLs allowed to query this view. If empty, the Match client ACLs are used.

field.label: Allow transfer ACLs
field.help: Default ACLs allowed to transfer zones in this view. Zone-specific settings can override this.

field.label: Forwarders
field.help: Optional recursive forwarding servers for this view.

field.label: DNSSEC Validation
field.help: Validate DNSSEC for recursive queries in this view.
